# `<e-back-top>`

<!-- No screenshot found. Run the screenshots test to generate one. -->

Floating button that scrolls the window (or a target) to the top.

Hidden until the scroll position passes `visibility-height`. Click triggers
`window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })`. Position defaults to bottom-right but can
be overridden through CSS variables `--ink-back-top-bottom` and
`--ink-back-top-right`.

> Source: [back-top.ts](./back-top.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visibility-height` | `number` | `400` | Pixels of scroll required before the button appears. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Back to top'` | Accessible label on the button. |
| `target` | `string` | — | CSS selector for a scroll container; defaults to `window`. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `e-click` | `CustomEvent<{value: number}>` | Fired after the scroll-to-top is requested. `value` is the scroll position when the button was pressed. |

## Slots

_None._
